# Southern Edge Paint Co.

> Southern Edge Paint Co. is a Painter serving Marco Island, Florida. Southern Edge Paint Co. is a trusted Marco Island painting company specializing in interior painting, exterior painting, and residential repainting. We help homeowners protect and improve their homes with detailed prep work, professional craftsmanship, and clean, lasting finishes
